name: miro-strategy-app
description: Universal strategic advisor — competitive analysis, personas, campaigns, and roadmaps powered by AI and MiroFish simulation

scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:mirofish
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.utils.seed
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv run pytest tests/ -v
scripts.lint:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check app/
